snippet.title: ToneTrek – First Gameplay Peek (Color Puzzle Prototype)
snippet.description:
Here's an early look at ToneTrek, our upcoming logic puzzle game.

The goal: recreate a target image by stepping through a grid of tiles — each step changes the tile's color in a fixed sequence. The challenge is to do it in the fewest moves possible.

This 1-minute demo features raw gameplay from the development version (no sound yet).

💡 More features, levels, and polish are coming soon. Stay tuned!
